counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of other characteristic features of Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma such as palmar or plantar pits
Lack of genetic testing results to support Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma
decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it provides a more comprehensive explanation of the patient's presentation, including the genetic mutation in the SUFU gene, which is characteristic of Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome. R5, on the other hand, only provides a partial explanation based on the histopathological description.

rejected.why: Lack of genetic and clinical evidence to support the diagnosis of Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma
